tasks.name: Calculate BC Subplan Cancelled
tasks.description: 按「变更日期」截止到业务月份、排除「已归属到期失效」，按取消与恢复报表的「所属计划」分组汇总数量，并把每个分组挂到 Option Plans Summary 中对应的计划名上（大小写/前后缀差异通过 lower+trim 与后缀匹配归一），输出每个计划的 Cancelled 覆盖行。报表里没有出现的计划不产出覆盖行，下游回退到源文件里的取消列。

tasks.name: Union Plan Summary Inputs
tasks.description: 合并 Option Plans Summary 指标与取消恢复报表按计划算出的 Cancelled 覆盖行。

tasks.name: Aggregate Plan Summary

params.sql:
select
  plan_name,
  sum(case when [key] = 'Granted' then coalesce([value], 0) else 0 end) as granted,
  sum(case when [key] = 'Exercised' then coalesce([value], 0) else 0 end) as exercised,
  case
    when sum(case when [key] = 'Cancelled' and category_for_grouping = 'cancel_restore' then 1 else 0 end) > 0
      then sum(case when [key] = 'Cancelled' and category_for_grouping = 'cancel_restore' then coalesce([value], 0) else 0 end)
    else sum(case when [key] = 'Cancelled' then coalesce([value], 0) else 0 end)
  end as cancelled,
  sum(case when [key] = 'Awards Outstanding' then coalesce([value], 0) else 0 end) as outstanding
from {plans}
where trim(concat('', coalesce(plan_name, ''))) <> ''
group by plan_name
having sum(case when [key] = 'Awards Outstanding' then coalesce([value], 0) else 0 end) <> 0
order by plan_name

tasks.description: 按标准化计划名汇总 Granted、Exercised、Cancelled 和 Awards Outstanding；Cancelled 优先取取消与恢复报表算出的值（报表覆盖到的计划），报表里没有该计划时回退到源文件列；过滤 Outstanding 为 0 的计划。
